stem: A school has 4,200 students. A random sample of 160 students was asked whether they play a musical instrument. The sample percent and its margin of error were applied to all 4,200 students, giving plausible values from 840 to 1,260 for the number of students at the school who play a musical instrument. How many of the 160 sampled students play a musical instrument?
solution: The estimate is the midpoint of the range: \(\frac{840 + 1{,}260}{2} = 1{,}050\) students.
As a percent of the school: \(\frac{1{,}050}{4{,}200} = 0.25\), so the sample percent is 25%.
verify:
x = symbols('x')
mid = Rational(840 + 1260, 2)
sol = solve(Eq(x / 160 * 4200, mid), x)
assert sol == [40]
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == sol
